meta.location: DRACO Lab, University of Central Florida [building/room]
meta.note: Edit 'status' as offers arrive and commit — the site re-renders from this data. Do not add client names or dollar figures anywhere in this file.
meta.purpose_rule: NEVER describe what an instrument will be used for. 'notes' and 'alternatives' are for what makes a unit suitable and how to hand it over — specs, accessories, compliance limits, remote-control needs. No roles ('reference', 'baseline', 'comparator', 'device under test'), no signal paths, no methodology. Read together, per-item purposes reconstruct the measurement design and narrow down what is being benchmarked, which is exactly what the NDA covers. `npm run check:purpose` enforces this.

items.name: DC power analyzer / precision SMU
items.examples: Keysight N6705C, B2902B, or equivalent precision source/measure with integrated energy logging
items.alternatives: Any bench power analyzer or SMU capable of precision rail sourcing/measurement with data logging
items.notes: Remote control over LAN or USB is required; a front-panel-only unit will not work here. Send the interface cable if it is not a standard one.

items.name: High-rate multichannel DAQ
items.examples: NI USB-6363 or other X-series; any DAQ with 4+ differential channels at 100 kS/s per channel or better
items.alternatives: Simultaneous-sampling units preferred; at least one hardware-timestamped digital input line required
items.notes: The original terminal block or connector kit is worth including if you still have it. Third-party breakouts are rarely a clean fit.

items.name: Bench reference DMM (6.5-digit or better)
items.alternatives: Any 6.5-digit bench meter; a current calibration certificate is ideal, and we can calibrate if there is not one
items.notes: If it is already in calibration, send the certificate along with it. If it is not, ours will be the fresh one.

items.name: Oscilloscope, 4-channel, 200 MHz+
items.examples: Keysight InfiniiVision, Tektronix MSO/DSO series, Rigol MSO5000-class
items.alternatives: MSO preferred; SCPI or USB remote control strongly preferred
items.notes: Probes and the original compensation kit are welcome alongside the instrument. Remote control matters more to us than bandwidth headroom.

items.name: Current probe + amplifier
items.examples: Tektronix TCP0030A with TCPA amplifier, or Hall/clamp probe with bench amplifier
items.alternatives: Any calibrated DC-capable current probe covering 0–15 A
items.notes: The matching amplifier needs to travel with the probe head, along with any degauss or zeroing fixture.

items.name: Thermal / IR camera
items.examples: Teledyne FLIR A- or E-series, Fluke Ti-series
items.notes: Compliance constraint: the manufacturer must not be Hikvision or Dahua, or a rebrand of either (HikMicro included). Section 889 applies, and we verify by manufacturer rather than by label.

items.name: Workstation with PCIe Gen4 x16 slot
items.examples: Dell Precision or HPE Z-class tower, 750 W+ PSU
items.alternatives: Any recent tower we can hold at a fixed BIOS and software configuration for the duration
items.notes: We will not reimage or repartition it, and we change nothing you have installed. Tell us about any licences tied to the machine.

items.name: Datacenter GPU access (H100/A100)
items.examples: Node time on a campus cluster or lab server — approximately 2–3 weeks intermittent use
items.alternatives: A100 acceptable; a local physical card is preferred over a cloud allocation
items.notes: Scheduled intermittent blocks rather than a continuous reservation. Physical access to the card is worth more to us than a larger allocation.

items.name: Precision electronic load or resistor bank
items.examples: Keysight/BK bench e-load, or a precision power resistor set
items.alternatives: Anything that can hold a stable, repeatable setpoint
items.notes: Front-panel-only control is acceptable for this one. A resistor set needs its published tolerances.

items.name: Thermocouple logger / TC module
items.examples: Keysight DAQ970A with TC card, Omega handheld loggers, any multi-channel TC readout
items.notes: Include the thermocouples you normally pair with it if they are not captive.

items.name: PCIe riser/interposer with power breakout
items.examples: Adexelec or similar PCIe extender exposing slot 12 V / 3.3 V rails
items.alternatives: An older Gen3 unit is still useful to us
items.notes: New units carry a long lead time, so even a short loan helps.

items.name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin dev kit
items.notes: The original power supply and carrier board are more useful to us than a bare module.

items.name: FPGA development board
items.examples: AMD/Xilinx VCU/ZCU-class or Intel/Altera dev boards
items.alternatives: Board class is negotiable — talk to us
items.notes: Include the programming cable if it is not integrated, and any node-locked licence details we would need.
